column1: # PA -> control-family map (docs/QUALITY_POLICY.md). One row per PA in docs/PREVENTIVE_ACTIONS.md; IDs are immutable.
# Edit by hand; then run scripts/quality_index.py to regenerate docs/quality/CONTROL_INDEX.md. Checked by tests/test_quality_controls.py.

column8: correction

Deriving expected values from the implementation can make tests tautological. Derive collection membership from an independent contract where appropriate; retain fixed externally justified golden values. One general test-oracle rule replaces PA-0027's overlapping wording.

Useful for systemic/security failures, but a whole-codebase sweep and immediate remediation for every minor defect creates unbounded scope. Define the failure mechanism, affected surface, search evidence, and risk-based disposition; separate unrelated fixes into backlog items.

Retain the architectural principle and owner checks. Merge PA-0021, 0063 and related extensions into one control covering producers, readers, normalization and selection. One implementation per invariant does not require one global function for unrelated semantics.

Keep a fresh-install/default-configuration smoke test. Move environment-incident history to its incident record and combine with dependency/runtime compatibility controls; the operational default should be tested where provisioned.

Sound requirement, but combines packaging and test realism. Use clean-install checks plus one representative real-backend contract test; combine PA-0009, 0035 and 0070 rather than rereading their separate narratives.

Keep production-shaped fixtures and prohibit test-only state that bypasses the handoff being verified. Merge PA-0043, 0071 and 0089. Test doubles remain legitimate for other, explicitly isolated behaviors.

Ambient cookies are not proof of authentication. Keep differential protected-resource/identity checks. The cited cookie-predicate test covers only part of the broad rule; map each authentication mechanism to its actual behavioral test.

Prefer the capability actually needed, but distinguish cheap availability discovery from qualification. Fold into PA-0009/0035's replacement; do not repeat an expensive end-to-end probe on every call.

Keep verification in the image/environment build once per immutable environment. Reuse the qualified artifact. A successful install alone is insufficient, but every ordinary change need not repeat a cold install.

The active replacement is PA-0026's adapter contract. Archive the original example and retain its regression tests; forcing both the general lesson and successive refinements to remain active adds no new obligation.

Keep real chain verification and profile-specific extension checks in the CA suite. Shorten the active instruction to the supported verifier contract; the historical extension inventory belongs beside the implementation/profile.

Keep bounded shutdown, in-flight cancellation and deliberate durability requirements. Merge with PA-0125/0128. The blanket promise that abrupt stop loses nothing needs an explicit recovery-point objective rather than an impossible universal guarantee.

Keep independent protocol examples and reject false test premises. Merge with the test-oracle control. The cited duplicate-length test is one regression, not proof that all future self-tests have correct premises.

Keep supported-engine qualification and bounded, scoped cleanup. Merge PA-0018/0059. Automatic teardown/retry needs explicit data-preservation and ownership limits; do not force destructive self-healing for every failure.

Commands advertised as verified must have recorded qualification evidence. Not every state-changing command needs a bespoke self-testing script; reusable smoke checks and clearly labelled unverified instructions are sufficient for lower-risk operations.

The warning about final AND lists is useful; the suggested blanket append of '|| true' can hide a real failure in B. Use explicit if/else and preserve intended failure statuses. Maintain both-branch shell tests in the affected suite.
Retain controlled comparisons and metrics that measure their stated property. Merge with PA-0064/0069's evidence standard. Do not demand a new narrative for every diagnostic counter.
The mechanism/caller sweep is valuable. Fold into the lifecycle control with PA-0014/0059 and the shared-owner registry. Archive the podman-specific chronology outside the active instruction.

Re-reading scope statements before every turn ends is memory-based process overhead. Its own successor PA-0020 acknowledges that weakness. Replace both with one structured change record and a nonsemantic completion check.
column9: Its memory-based reread is retired; the structural check in .claude/hooks/check_bookkeeping.py replaces it (BUG-0157).

column8: Automate high-risk checkable requirements, not every lapse. The current keyword Stop hook blocks harmless timeout documentation and can be satisfied by touching ERROR_LOG. Replace keyword suspicion with explicit change type, risk and required evidence fields.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0157): the keyword Stop hook is replaced by declared Change-Type/Risk commit trailers plus a structural bug-record check (.claude/hooks/check_bookkeeping.py).

column8: Two distinct controls are bundled: shared derivation belongs in L02; typed validation belongs in L03. Preserve underlying tests, remove the claim that every foreseeable library failure must always be converted into one exception type.

A universal word-boundary remedy is technically wrong for URLs, identifiers and concatenated destructive names; PA-0122/0301 already expose that. Require grammar-aware matching and false-positive/false-negative fixtures for the actual language.

Keep explicit connection ownership/per-thread connection factories and two-thread tests where shared use is possible. A docstring alone is not enforcement. Scope the invariant to the real call topology instead of forcing thread-local handles everywhere.

Keep a registry-discovered compatibility matrix for newly admitted shapes. Run affected emitter combinations, with the full cross-emitter check at the integration gate; do not duplicate broad rendering in every tiny change loop.

column7: No finding is not confirmed secure
column8: A failed/unexercised tool must be inconclusive. Preserve connectivity/execution evidence and behavioral controls. Avoid conflating a clean tool exit, absence of findings, and proven absence of a vulnerability.

Keep explicit supported input shapes and relationship constraints. Combine with PA-0010 and protocol contract tests. Exhaustive enumeration of every hidden third-party assumption is impossible; define a bounded supported contract and adversarial boundary cases.
Retain identity-keyed fault injection. Fold its expected-set wording into corrected PA-0001; do not compute expected behavior using the same predicate being tested without an independent oracle.

Good fail-closed boundary: reject transformations whose correctness needs missing surrounding context. Keep explicit trusted provenance and adversarial trailing-context cases; this is a substantive invariant, not removable paperwork.

Retain an allowed exception plus an independent injected defect as a paired fixture. Merge into guard qualification with PA-0034 instead of adding a new global reviewer checklist item for each conditional.

Explicitly superseded by PA-0046. Keep historical traceability and existing regressions, remove it from the active reading set. Observation and redirect-policy controls should have one current version.

Preallocation reduces a problem created by shared sequential counters but still centralizes coordination. Use immutable collision-resistant record IDs and generated human-readable indices; retain reservations only during migration, not as permanent production work.

Keep the principle of acting within already authorized scope. Merge with clear escalation rules, distinguishing a status message from a permission request. The later user-message reset rules must not override the user's actual intent.

Two unique CWEs per example is an invalid quality proxy: independent examples may correctly share one root weakness. Keep any still-authorized sample-count deliverable separately, but replace uniqueness quotas with accurate mapping and scenario diversity. Do not silently change a prior user-requested deliverable.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0157): the two-unique-CWE quota is removed from .claude/hooks/check-corpus-cwe-coverage.sh; the owner-requested five-pairs-per-class floor stays.

column7: Adversarial tests for generated code and guards
column8: Both ideas are valuable. Separate generated-code behavior qualification from guard positive/negative controls, then merge into L07/L10. A synthetic offender proves one failure shape, not universal guard adequacy.

Keep real-path qualification with explicit deadlines. Separate inexpensive capability discovery, immutable-environment qualification and live health checks; probing the real network on every import is waste, as BUG-0142 demonstrates.

Keep explicit naming ownership and representative real-framework checks. Merge with generator compatibility controls. Archive the 277-word Rails incident narrative; the current rule can be stated in two sentences.

Split into lockfile/runtime compatibility and representative multi-request integration. Pin demonstrated incompatibilities, manage updates, and qualify a built environment once; blanket hand-pinning every potentially troublesome transitive dependency creates maintenance debt.

column7: Tracked ground truth and separate pytest run
column8: Keep tracked-artifact completeness checks. A second invocation solely to obtain a file-level pass count is redundant when JUnit/node IDs already prove collection and execution on the same tree. Derive per-file evidence from the single authoritative run.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15: scripts/verify_change.py writes per-file results from the authoritative run (manifest.json); no second pytest run is needed to show a file ran.

column8: The file already says PA-0053/0054 supersede it. Keep language-conversion regressions and archive the obsolete instruction. A str(None) cast is not a complete absent-input contract.

Keep a final cross-emitter integration backstop. Replace repeated whole-repository runs at every intermediate step with dependency/contract-based selection and one full run on the candidate integration tree. Remove conflict with the newer selector policy.
Preserve one seam conformance suite covering security settings, signatures and placement. Merge PA-0046/0072/0115's related additions without losing their distinct assertions.
Keep one end-to-end classification/scoring check for new category mappings. Share a qualified lab fixture and reuse the evidence; isolated strategy success alone does not prove pipeline scoring.

Useful data-contract check; merge with PA-0006/0071 and keep the real construction-path test. Specify cardinality and keys explicitly so PA-0048's later one-to-many correction is not a separate competing instruction.

The assertion-dependency issue is real, but grep-and-rerun-everything is brittle and duplicates PA-0040/0403. Move independent counts to a ground-truth contract and dependency map; use the full integration check as backstop.

column7: Edit as many assertions as grep finds
column8: Counting edits is not proof of correctness: some matches need no change and one correct shared expectation can fix many tests. Replace with independent contract assertions and node-level execution evidence; archive this local incident workaround.

Keep explicit no-follow policy for observation senders and manual approved redirects where needed. Merge seam conformance and trust-anchor rules; retain exemptions based on the consumer's actual contract, not an HTTP-wide prohibition.

Retain independent ground-truth mapping tests and scored integration coverage. Merge PA-0042. Replace blanket underscore spelling advice with an explicit canonical schema mapping; preserve any legitimate established names.

Preserve all distinct legitimate contexts through the join. The historical statement that duplicates are safe is incomplete, as PA-0073 proves. State allowed multiplicity per consumer and deduplicate confirmation at its actual key.

Retain target-platform resolution and clean artifact installation. Merge PA-0037/0070, checking every dependency root through discovery; run on lockfile/runtime changes and the release qualification lane.

Any HTTP response may prove HTTP reachability, not readiness; 500/401 can still mean the app is unusable for the task. Define separate owned-listener, liveness and workload-readiness checks with expected outcomes, aligned with PA-0149.

Retain fault-present/benign-clear tests against the framework's actual exception/reporting hooks. Merge real-runtime qualification. Move Laravel implementation detail to the adapter contract and incident archive.

Retain nondefault-target tests. Host-only scoping conflicts with PA-0123's origin default; replace the historical exception with explicit scheme/host/port policy. A test hostname must not imply authorization for live external traffic.
Preserve the principle but use the complete PA-0054/0056/0058 contract once. Tests must cover handler method, channels, declared outcome and both twins; a navigation crawl alone is insufficient.

Keep offline declared-route coverage and a representative live sweep. Merge the later method/channel/status refinements into one contract matrix; keep known exceptions as traceable defects, not permanent expanded prose.
The entry explicitly says 'No new rule'; it records completed corrective work. Move completion evidence to its bug/change record and retain tests under the consolidated absent-input control.
Keep these essential refinements in the same route contract as PA-0054. Use one parametrized matrix and one exception registry, removing duplicate sweep/pinning instructions.

Keep artifact/runtime debug-off settings and response-content tests because source leakage invalidates lab comparisons. Consolidate repeated per-stack source scans and run live checks on the affected built stacks.

Keep shared enums and both-twin declared outcomes. The example mentions different bodies, but the rule focuses on statuses; explicitly define the allowed body differences too. Archive stale lane-reconciliation assignments after checking current completion.

Useful: exit code is not always sufficient. Derive resource inventories from owned compose state and centralize cleanup; do not retain a manually duplicated service list plus a standing instruction to remember updating it.
Keep a cheap declarative linter with stage-alias exceptions. This is a narrow, valid build portability rule, not a reason for extra whole-suite or human review rounds.
PA-0062 supersedes the header-only workaround, but neither establishes browser equivalence. Preserve intentional client-profile tests and move fingerprinting history out of the active global policy.

A copied header dictionary cannot guarantee actual browser behavior; Sec-Fetch claims can contradict the request context. Make client profiles explicit and measured per supported flow, and avoid resetting standing authorized scope merely to change implementation headers.

Keep one scoped selection owner and behavioral tests across producers/runs. Merge PA-0066/0067/0075/0076 into an explicit provenance/identity contract rather than an ever-longer chain of scope amendments.

Keep verified partitions, degenerate-input behavior and explicit in-sample labels. This protects scientific validity. Share fixtures and one splitter contract; removing these tests would trade quality for misleading numbers.

Keep a real-browser page smoke and no-silent-skip release lane. Run affected pages during iteration and the route-wide smoke on shared layout/CSP changes or integration; distinguish HTTP-only changes from rendering claims.

Keep two-run/two-target independence tests and explicit join keys. Merge into the data provenance control. One representative multi-run fixture can cover several readers without rebuilding the same dataset for each prose rule.
Retain named consumer scope and re-open incorrect prior verdicts. Require risk-bounded impact evidence for affected readers, not a full resweep of unrelated historic sites after every routine defect.
Keep distribution identity, clearing paired columns and consumer checks. Merge duplicate wording with the holdout family, but preserve separately testable calibration and score-provenance invariants.

Keep exact deterministic tests of the stated bound plus non-vacuity. Distinguish an empirical calibration-set property from a statistical future-data guarantee; the text should state assumptions and scope explicitly.

Keep package contents and built-runtime smoke at packaging/release boundaries. Recursive globs are an implementation choice, not a universal quality law; the independently derived artifact inventory is the invariant.
Keep producer/consumer contract tests and reasons for intentionally unwritten columns. AST detection of a write is a useful lint, not proof that the write is reachable or happens before a read.
Split wrapper forwarding into seam conformance and pending/atomic row state into L08/L05. They share an incident, not one control mechanism; keeping them bundled obscures ownership.
Keep at-most-one confirmation/finding per full identity and explicit golden-change reasoning. Consolidate PA-0048's incomplete safety claim into this corrected contract.

Keep a common metric/baseline function over identical rows and deterministic tie semantics. Constant-score non-vacuity is valuable. Scope the input-order prohibition to claimed statistical metrics, not all legitimate stable sorts.
Keep recorded acted-on run IDs and fail-safe legacy handling. Merge with scoped model selection and file handoff provenance; open-ended model applicability must not be treated as execution evidence.

Keep all semantically required identity fields and shared normalization. Replace 'every field both sides record' with an explicit domain key; timestamps and other coincident columns are not necessarily identity.

Keep per-plugin validation, isolation and visible reasons. Merge with PA-0086's per-unit boundary rule, preserving critical system errors that should propagate rather than be converted into plugin rejection.

Retain production-derived count tests. Merge with provenance and realistic fixtures; reconstructed counts can be valid when mathematically guaranteed, but the posterior parameters here do not uniquely encode pulls.

Perform pure usage checks before writes/sends and mark started runs aborted on later failures. Calling every import a prohibited side effect is too broad; define irreversible/external effects and permitted initialization precisely.

column7: Path containment and private secret creation
column8: Keep validated names, contained filesystem operations and secure creation. Clarify that untrusted input may become a path after validated resolution; O_NOFOLLOW on the leaf alone does not establish every directory's trust.
Keep the central gate and behavioral bind tests. Merge launched-server coverage from PA-0130; one current control should distinguish static lint from authoritative runtime exposure checks.
Retain manual checked redirects, but remove the response-derived login-page origin as an authority. PA-0098/0099/0134 supply the corrected operator-anchor/origin/transport contract.

Keep effect-counting tests and normalized/raw gate behavior. Replace 'test every never/always docstring' with explicit safety requirements and clause-level evidence; arbitrary wording searches are not a safety inventory.

Keep context-aware signals and positive/escaped negative fixtures. Incorporate container/response executability and grammar uncertainty from later rules; static structure must not be represented as observed browser execution.

column7: Shared secret sensitivity and persistence tests
column8: Keep the shared predicate and every persisted-copy checks; merge PA-0091/0100/0101/0455 into one redaction boundary contract with explicit conservative omission behavior.

column7: Validate user rules and isolate unit failures
column8: Keep validation at rule creation and per-unit failure reporting. Share PA-0077's control while specifying which failures are containable and which must abort safely.

column7: One specific policy decision and authority parser
column8: Keep deny precedence and IPv6-aware authority parsing. Clarify specificity: broad policy may intentionally deny more, but less-specific fallback must not override an established deny.

Keep injected-failure and concurrent-first-open tests. Merge file/history variants, allowing storage-appropriate compare-and-swap/versioned transactions instead of prescribing BEGIN IMMEDIATE to every backend.

Retain production-path on/off tests only for switches intended to alter the tested observable. The universal assertion that indistinguishable runs imply a defect is false when a fixture never reaches the optional behavior.

Keep keyed callback proof and reflection-only negatives. Scope 'proof not derivable from probe' to signals that claim remote execution/fetch, not every confirmation mechanism or intentionally computed arithmetic probe.

Keep name-form by value-shape cases and whole-sensitive-subtree replacement. Fold into one redaction contract; share the matrix across persistence producers rather than repeating complete independent fixture construction.

Keep per-target durable membership and label-flip invariance with a live control. This is a strong scientific-integrity control. Retain the expensive full mutation scenario in the ML lane, not every unrelated docs edit.

column7: Deny before allow and reviewed deviations
column8: Keep mandatory transport denials. Merge with corrected origin-bound session controls. A deviation affecting safety needs explicit risk review; minor implementation divergence within the approved invariant does not require reopening three-party design consensus.

Keep script-type/src/template/ancestor fixtures inside the XSS context matrix. Merge PA-0084/0103/0127; container executability and surrounding response type are distinct test dimensions of one signal contract.

The rescan bug was real, but nested loops are not automatically quadratic when total work is partitioned, and every flow-path function does not warrant a counter. Target demonstrated/high-volume hotspots with independent operation counts and representative performance budgets.
Keep huge integers, NaN/inf, shape, depth and byte limits. A predicate's totality is relative to documented inputs; distinguish expected malformed-input refusal from hiding programming/system errors.

Keep full-write checks, secure staging and directory fsync. The statement that every error leaves the original intact is impossible after rename; distinguish pre-publication rollback from published-but-durability-unknown and test each state.

Keep authorization before every fetch and fail closed on redirect-incapable clients. Consolidate earlier credential rules under this authoritative anchor so the obsolete login-page-origin exception is no longer active prose.

column7: Credential transport floor at every send
column8: Keep fresh/cached/artifact-handoff coverage and post-retarget authorization. Merge with PA-0134's origin-bound contract, preserving transport and origin as separate mandatory dimensions.

Keep all producers using the redaction boundary and behavioral persisted-secret tests. The AST producer list is a supporting lint; a synthetic offender does not prove discovery of arbitrary future write shapes.

Keep bounded malformed/deep/compressed/chunked cases and omission of unprovably clean data. Preserve an explicit omission reason so loss of history fidelity is visible. This safety control should not be removed for speed.

Keep byte caps, absolute deadlines, incremental accumulation and nonblocking event-loop behavior. Scope the buffer-copy prohibition to growing-buffer recopy, not every harmless bytes conversion inside a loop.

Keep the actual ambiguous-syntax regressions and fail-inconclusive behavior. 'Every grammar ambiguity' is unbounded; document supported syntax and use a qualified parser or execution check when that boundary is exceeded.

Keep nonfinite/range checks at scoring boundaries and batch refusal semantics. Avoid adding redundant validation of every arithmetic operation when a domain-boundary proof or shared checked primitive already establishes the invariant.

Keep append-only security/integrity state and migration backfill where justified. A separate append-only table for every kind of safety state is overbroad; document needed durability and version semantics per state.

Keep named expected-error handling and propagation tests. Allow intentionally broad last-resort cleanup/reporting boundaries where documented; a raw exception-class AST pattern cannot substitute for semantic error-policy review.
Keep prepare-before-write, writer-owned rollback boundaries and retry-once tests. Merge PA-0088/0097. Savepoints are appropriate on a shared SQLite connection, not a universal transaction mechanism.

Keep one shape-validating parser, counted quarantine and no fabricated rows. Merge PA-0454/0500 while distinguishing malformed public data from unknown security state, which must fail closed rather than appear missing.

Keep a lock spanning read through atomic replacement and two-process tests. Broaden the wording to equivalent atomic transactions or compare-and-swap; an interprocess file lock is not the only correct shared-store mechanism.

Keep success tied to completed effects and exact no-op cases. Merge with error policy and post-state checks. A separate read-back after every successful primitive is unnecessary if its documented success semantics are authoritative.

Use explicit supported algorithm rules, traceable fixtures and captured third-party shapes where relevant. Do not imply a small hand-maintained rule table proves complete browser emulation; run differential real-browser checks for risky serialization/session behaviors.

Keep clause-level enforcement and actual removal/attack tests. A test-name-exists check validates references, not effectiveness; maintain owner, layer, behavioral evidence and last qualification instead of treating linkage percentage as quality.

The blanket 'base URL is never truncated' contradicts legitimate origin-key derivation and its own stored-path exception. Specify which type each operation needs: deployment base, absolute request path or origin. Keep subpath cases and server-declared cookie scope.

Keep source-based inventory and compensating controls before live use of a new target. Automate a versioned target profile; rerun when that target's source/profile changes, not on unrelated feature edits.

Keep refuse-instead-of-relocate behavior and discovered concrete sender tests. This is a real end-to-end seam invariant; combine with signature/transport conformance without reducing placement assertions.

Keep benign controls, stable baselines and fresh-token replication. State category-specific replication/noise criteria and request budgets; universal repetition across every possible mechanism can inflate production probe counts without equivalent evidence gain.

Keep canonical URL/segment/query keys and lab-vocabulary counterexamples. Replace PA-0022's conflicting generic word-boundary rule for this domain. AST checks remain lints, supported by actual auth-state behavior tests.

column7: Origin scope across browser sending layers
column8: Keep driver/API/browser-layer confinement, redirect checks and per-layer evidence. Maintain both layers because they see different traffic; avoid consolidating away genuinely independent safety defenses merely because their descriptions overlap.

column7: Complete classifier outputs and probe filters
column8: Keep discovered shape-category mappings, deliberate exclusions and filter limitations. Separate classification completeness from confirmer probe diversity; merge related requirements into their respective owners instead of bundling unrelated mechanisms by incident.

429 orphaned servers and approximately 14 GB are material evidence for this control. Keep ownership-safe group cleanup and owner-death tests. Move platform/PID internals to procutil's contract so every contributor need not memorize them.

column7: Shared browser launch and async observation
column8: Keep central launch configuration, real delayed-sink tests and visible no-verdict startup failure. Merge browser lifecycle/scope ownership while preserving the executor's distinct observation contract.

Keep HTML content-type/download preconditions and non-HTML echo negatives. Merge into the XSS/redirect confirmation matrix; do not repeat the full historical evolution from nested script context to response context.

Keep source-first shutdown and in-flight tests. 'Enough runs, here 80' is historical evidence, not a universal sample size; use failure-frequency/risk-based repeated qualification and a regression reproducer when available.
Keep fresh-token validation and real-page noise per evidence channel. Handling ambient dialogs is necessary but must never become a vulnerability hit; this is essential label-integrity protection.

Keep explicit loopback launch and authoritative owned-socket checks, plus private-netns wildcard tests. Static and runtime checks have different purposes; cache invariant metadata but do not remove live safety checks merely to shorten tests.

Keep grammar-specific primitives and structural-character counterexamples. Merge PA-0456 and typed URL/text contracts. The current '?' AST heuristic is a local lint with explicit exceptions, not a general parser-correctness proof.

Keep transferable browser-established state and consumer-specific tests, filtered by origins/secure/path rules. 'All state the first client holds' needs a minimum-required-state boundary, not indiscriminate credential copying.
Keep realistic echoed edit forms, reflection negatives and bidirectional mutation checks. It catches a distinct false-negative class; run its owned suite when disqualifier/context logic changes.

column7: Origin-bound secrets and isolated browser state
column8: Keep origin membership on secret artifacts and actual receiving-server tests. Hostname checks and cookie suppression alone are insufficient. Move review-round annotations and client construction history to the incident, retaining one clear current contract.

Deterministic operation counts are good for algorithmic complexity. The universal ban on wall-clock ratios and mandatory runtime counters is too broad: real performance also depends on I/O, allocation and native work. Use controlled benchmarks alongside independent count tests.

Keep one refusal helper and document-vs-subresource behavioral tests. Merge into the browser navigation contract. The abort-code detail should be discoverable at its owner, not a separate universal reading obligation.

Keep expected-failure containment, later-candidate continuation and no fabricated negatives. Clarify probe/mechanism/candidate status transitions and preserve unexpected defects; bounded inconclusive is not success or secure.

Keep commit/load/failed-navigation ownership and content provenance. The entry is an implementation design plus amendment history; replace active text with the helper contract and its typed outcomes, retaining detailed browser regressions.

Keep supported quoting/encoding coverage and negative controls. 'Every probe set spans all quote kinds' is too broad for syntax-constrained vulnerabilities; use a declared context/filter coverage matrix with measured missed cases.

Keep goals, progress visibility and escalation. A fixed six-hour flat single metric need not mean no useful progress; use milestone-specific evidence and cumulative spend. Report at agreed task cadence without manufacturing a full bug/CAPA for every plateau.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0156): the stall clock no longer restarts on any user message; a quoted stall decision suspends the gate for its stated hours.

column8: Keep must-fix/follow-up separation and a review budget. The implementation counts individual reviewer requests, not paired rounds; two reviewers consume two slots. Define a round precisely and escalate unresolved material risk, not an arbitrary request count.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0156): a review round is the set of review requests between two work dispatches; the cap is cleared only by a quoted review decision.

column8: Defer unrelated enhancements, but permit fixes already implied by the active goal and delegated risk envelope. Any later user message is not approval of self-opened scope; require task-specific authorization when a real scope expansion needs it.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0156): self-opened scope needs a quoted scope decision, not any later user message.

column8: Keep rework-chain visibility and targeted redesign after regressions. A universal two-bug stop ignores severity, independence and progress; use significant linked regressions or time-budget breach as a review trigger rather than an automatic user dependency.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0156): the bug-chain hold is cleared by a recorded disposition (systemic-diagnosis trigger, QUALITY_POLICY R1), not by contact.

column8: Keep cumulative actual/forecast spend and explicit escalation. The current user-message reset can erase a real overrun after a status question. Only an explicit scope/budget decision may reset the budget; default limits should fit task size.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0156): spend is cumulative across contact, close/reopen and rename; only a quoted budget decision extends it, by stated hours.

column8: Keep low work-in-progress and planned integration for overlapping edits. Three is a provisional capacity limit, not a quality constant. Measure queue/merge cost before tuning, and include shared-contract overlap from PA-0152.

Keep goal re-grounding after compaction and honest progress reports. Forcing a raw full ledger before every status answer adds reader waste; lead with outcome, risk and next step, with the full ledger linked. Do not mistake unrelated contact for authorization.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15 (BUG-0156): the report leads with the metric, unchanged-since time and holds; decisions are listed with their verification state.

column8: Strong measured improvement: repeated installs dominated test boots. Retain keyed, locked, complete publication and cache-specific tests. Clarify that mutable network availability is not invariant forever; define cache scope/invalidation and cold qualification separately.

column7: Server readiness ownership and intermittent failures
column8: Keep process-owned listener readiness. Requiring every concurrency failure to be deterministic or already tied to a resource before containment is unrealistic; preserve unresolved status, reproduce statistically, collect telemetry, and allow justified temporary isolation with an owner/expiry.

Keep outcome/ownership assertions in races. Exact counts can still be valid when instrumented actions have unique correlation IDs, even with other actors present. State the actual determinism condition rather than banning counts by actor presence.

Keep a deterministic large-input test for the actual bug. Banning every early-exit pipeline is overly broad and capturing output can increase memory use; use a bounded stream and deliberate producer/SIGPIPE status handling appropriate to the command contract.

Keep code-derived consumer inventory, lane communication and one final integration check. Merge PA-0002/0067/0146, replacing duplicated per-component prose with one change record linked to the affected contracts.

Postdates the proposal snapshot; mapped at implementation. Same invariant as PA-0137 (an external failure is no verdict, never a negative or the end of a run), extended to HTTP senders with one classifier (SP-34) and an AST sender guard. Keep its tests; read it through L06 with PA-0137.

Keep independent subpath tests and explicit origin-vs-route joins. Parameter-name AST discovery misses aliases and creates renaming sensitivity; prefer typed URL contracts with a registry backstop. Merge PA-0113 and archive repeated sweep history.

Keep independent compounds/nouns/order fixtures and complete target-route dispositions. Maintain explicit heuristic limitations and compensating controls; more spellings alone cannot guarantee destructive-action detection.

Keep engine-independent namespace checks and errors-as-unknown/refused. Qualification should cover supported engine modes, not force exhaustive all-engine behavior per ordinary change. Run exposure checks where the external lab is started.

Keep error-path negatives and a positive control proving the observation channel can carry the violation. Move app-specific log details to target qualification. Correct evidence is more useful than extra count/shape documentation.

Keep parser-discovered action coverage, refusal of unrepresentable shapes and verbatim forwarding when appropriate. It is a targeted deterministic contract test; it does not justify two human design reviewers on a routine flag change.

Keep equality between acted-on and forwarded effective values under the downstream parser. Merge PA-0400 while retaining this deliberate exception to verbatim forwarding; state parser precedence as an explicit assumption.
Keep bounded repo/named-path checks and external-cwd/basetemp regressions. This directly limits false positives and wasted filesystem work; combine shared snapshots with PA-0452 where safe.

The missed-guard defect is real, but selecting every whole file with ast.parse/os.walk couples a fast guard to all its expensive behavioral tests. Split guard functions into a cheap lane and map affected contract suites explicitly; full-suite qualification remains a backstop.
column9: Corrected 2026-10-15: auto-detected guard files contribute only their guard test nodes to a --base selection; --full stays the backstop.

column8: Keep producer-returned evidence and stale-file/empty-producer tests. Merge with PA-0075's provenance principle, preserving independent filesystem handoff cases and intentional per-project output ownership.

Keep schema identity/definition validation and benign legacy-store fixtures. Merge PA-0453/0456 into the current complete contract; exact-byte comparison needs explicit supported migration/version behavior, not a silent compatibility broadening.

Keep test isolation and no-unintended-file effects. The absolute ban on implicit built-in output is a product policy, not a universal quality rule; state it for this UI and retain the authorized proxy exception. Fixture enforcement should not be counted as unenforced.

Keep full untrusted-schema validation before reads and bounded handling of executable SQLite structure. It repairs a real allowlist gap; merge historical PA-0451 wording rather than forcing contributors to reconstruct successive versions.

Keep shape/size checks and parser-limit handling. 'Missing or malformed, never an exception' is unsafe as a universal rule for authorization/sealing state. Return a typed malformed outcome and require each consumer's fail-closed or quarantine policy.
